notes: The LONG, from chapter templates. The director picks chapter TYPES and each
expands to its own small shot list from `templates/chapters/`.
ALL SIXTEEN TYPES HAVE A FILE. The nine that used to be here were named for
a story shape — `the-unit`, `both-hands`, `the-event` — and six of the
sixteen types the director may actually write expanded to nothing at all.
There is no dive and no progression. Both were register-kit motions: a
lobby-to-monitor transition strip and a light/clutter/clock advance across
the runtime, neither of which the v2 kit draws. The room CHANGES ANGLE
instead, which is a cut rather than a transition.
